# OLYMPUS v0.0.3, a walkable barracks on a laid-out base: the build sheet

Written 2026-11-06 for the round's four implementers (places, people, stage, hud) and the lead who integrates: the contract between roles building in parallel without talking. Where it is silent the docs decide (DESIGN.md and the user's two rules of 2026-11-05, then TECH §1.3 on implementation, then the sections); my own choices are marked (my call); every disagreement settled here is in §8.

**The release.** ROADMAP §4.1's "0.0.4 a walkable barracks on a laid-out base" row, cut as v0.0.3 (CONTRACTS §18). **The user plays**: "walk the bay at night and in the morning, out to the street at dawn and across the base to its fences". **Acceptance moment 2** (ROADMAP §4.4), "The bay at 23:00": the squad bay at 23:00 under the fire watch's red lamp, past sleepers in their racks; at dawn, the stairs and out to the company street as the canyon wall lets the sun in. Must hold: nobody pops in or out; the fog dims what the character cannot see, from the same function perception uses; the wall clock and the watch agree; 60 fps with p95 at or under 18 ms (`squadbay-night`). The look round has no scores: the figures stay the samples' set (ROADMAP §4.6), the chibi by default.

**The two rules of 2026-11-05 hold over every section.** (1) Places are handcrafted: every area, room, fixture, lamp and dressing is authored and the same in every career; a layout may be computed at load by a deterministic authored rule (no seed of the world or the career, no rng), and every look seed is an authored constant. (2) All people are generated from the world's seed, the player included (until the enlistment paper, 0.0.13).

**Rules of the round** are the brief's: write only your own files (§1); a change you need elsewhere goes in your report's issues list, written out exactly. No commits. Never touch `.play/`, :8200, :8201, the sibling projects (read them freely). Heavy browser tests on your own `OLYMPUS_TEST_PORT`; kill every server you start. Look at what you draw (`node tools/shot.mjs`) before you report.

**Interfaces first.** Each role first writes the modules others import, exact exports and signatures, behaviour stubbed (places: `model.js`, `light.js`, `sun.js`, `clocks.js`, `doors.js`, `hand.js`, `portals.js`, `sight.js`, `fixtures.js` seats, and `echo.js`'s rooms and openings before their fixtures; people: `perception.js`, `figure.js`, `place.js`, `domain.js`, `game.js`'s registration; stage: `view.js`'s new members; hud: `src/data/bench.js`, `debug.js`'s params). Until a dependency is real, test against a stub of your own and say so. **Merge order**: places, people, stage, hud, with `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` after each.

## 2. Interfaces

Signatures in JavaScript; `state` the saved state, `bus` the core bus, times integer game ms, positions metres in the area frame (x east, z south; the site frame for the ground), angles degrees unless the name says `Rad`.

### 2.1 places

**The areas.** `areaOf(id)` finds three new frozen records beside `test.rooms`: `melas.echo.1`, `melas.echo.2`, `melas.ground`. `MELAS_SITE.areas` lists all three. A floor's record keeps `TEST_AREA`'s shape and adds:

```js
{ id: 'melas.echo.1', site: 'melas', kind: 'floor', code: 'e1', name: 'Echo Company barracks, ground floor', level: 1,
  originM: [480, 0, 190],                                   // floor 2: [480, 3.4, 190]; the building frame is PLACES §4.4's
  boundsM: { x0: 0.3, z0: 0.3, x1: 83.7, z1: 23.7 },       // the rooms' envelope, so wallsOf() finds the outer walls (§8, item 23)
  spawn: { x, z, face },                                    // the player's berth foot when no billet decides (sandbox-style starts)
  rooms: [{ id: 'e1.bay-2-1', kind: 'squadBay', name: '1st Squad, 2nd Platoon', rect, ceilingM: 3.0, zone,
            floor: { kind, color, seed }, surface: 'tile',  // tile | vinyl | concrete | stairs: what the feet are on
            lighting: 'berthing',                           // berthing | head | hall | office (the lighting class, §4)
            owner: { unitId: '2/4-E-2-1' }, layout: 'A', windows: 2 }],
  openings: [{ id: 'o:e1:bay-2-1', kind: 'door', axis: 'x', at: 7.6, a: 57.2, b: 58.2, rooms, state: 'closed', leaf: 'hinged', openS: 1.0, closeS: 1.0 }],
  fixtures: [/* TEST_AREA's spec, plus: berths: ['ft2-r', 'ft2-aar'] (a rack's seats, lower first, billet keys of its room's owner, null spare);
               lockerIds, footlockerIds (each berth's, in the same order); faces: ['melas'] | ['melas', 'utc'] (a wallClock); dir: 'up' | 'down' (stairs) */],
  links: [{ id: 'l:echo:stair-e', kind: 'stairs', stops: [{ area: 'melas.echo.1', x, z, face }, { area: 'melas.echo.2', x, z, face }] }],
  portals: [{ id: 'o:e1:front', kind: 'door', via: 'o:e1:front',           // named by its opening or link (CONTRACTS §10)
              band: { axis: 'x', at: 23.7, a: 41.5, b: 42.5, out: 's' },  // the line crossed, and its outside
              to: { area: 'melas.ground', x: 522.0, z: 214.9, face: 'down' } }],
  posts: [{ id: 'fire-watch:2/4-E-2', unitId: '2/4-E-2', seatId: 'f:e1:bay-2-1:stool-1#1' }],
  look: { palette: 'mars', finish, decor: [{ kind: 'stencil', x, y, text: '1ST SQUAD', room }],
          lamps: [{ x, z, y, r, kind: 'ceiling' | 'night' | 'red' | 'desk' | 'exit', room }] } }
```

The ground's record:

```js
{ id: 'melas.ground', site: 'melas', kind: 'ground', name: 'Base Melas', originM: [0, 0, 0],
  boundsM: { x0: -40, z0: -40, x1: 1040, z1: 740 },        // Main Side's fence and GROUND_APRON_M of valley floor beyond, drawn
  walkM: { x0: 0, z0: 0, x1: 1000, z1: 700 },               // walked: inside the fence
  plan: 'melas@1',
  massing: [{ id: 'b:echo', rects, heightM: 7.4, open: false,
              doors: [{ id: 'o:melas:echo-front', x: 522, z: 214, side: 's', widthM: 1.0, opening: 'o:e1:front' }] }],  // opening: its leaf's one state
  surfaces: [{ kind: 'paving' | 'path' | 'regolith', rect } | { kind, pts, widthM }],   // roads, paths, parade deck, streets, aprons; regolith elsewhere
  fence: { rect: [0, 0, 1000, 700], heightM: 3, postM: 3 }, gates: [{ id: 'o:melas:gate-main', x: 0, z: 410, axis: 'z', widthM: 12, state: 'closed' }],
  fixtures: [/* the company streets' lamp posts, bins, the guidon post, painted formation marks: authored */],
  portals: [/* Echo's front, west and east exits, into the building */],
  look: { palette: 'mars', seed: 4417, lamps: [/* 'street' along the lines' streets and walks, 'flood' on the fence every 40 m */] } }
```

Rules the data obeys (`places-validate` checks each): a door on the ground is a reveal `DOOR_REVEAL_M` deep in its massing, blocked while its opening is closed; a portal fires when the walker's centre is `STEP_M` past its band on the `out` side within `a`..`b`; its `to` lies at least `PORTAL_CLEAR_M` inside the other area from that area's return band (hysteresis); a link's stops have the same x, z on both floors (the stair keeps its place on screen, VIEWS §2.9); floor 1 draws the flight going up and walks it (cost 15), floor 2 draws the well and walks only its top `STAIR_TOP_M`; decor sits on full-height walls (the north boundary); every portal has an exit sign (`sign`, make `exit`) within 1.5 m of its band; fixture `seed`s come from at most `SEEDS_PER_KIND` authored values per kind per area.

**Echo** (PLACES §4.4, in full on both floors). Floor 1: the east wing (2nd Platoon) as PLACES writes it; the core (`co`, `1sg`, `xo`, `hall-core`, `admin`, `lobby` with the duty desk and the two-faced clock standing on it, `vestibule` with its two doors, `stair-main`, `duty-room`, `mail`); the west wing (1st Platoon) mirrored about x 42. Floor 2: 3rd Platoon (west), Weapons Platoon (east), the classroom and the study room, three stairs. Layouts (authored once in the room's frame, mirrored with the west wing): bay-2-1 A, bay-2-2 B, bay-2-3 C, bay-1-1 C, bay-1-2 A, bay-1-3 B, bay-3-1 B, bay-3-2 C, bay-3-3 A, bay-w-1 A, bay-w-2 B, bay-w-3 C (my call: every layout on every wing). Each squad bay: 15 berths, a locker per berth, footlockers where the layout gives them, a study table and four stools, a wall clock (Melas face) and the squad's stencil on its north wall, two windows. **bay-2-1's berths (layout A, area frame)**, which people and the walk test both read:

| Rack (id `f:e1:bay-2-1:rack-…`) | x, z (centre), face | Lower (#2), upper (#3) |
|---|---|---|
| `n0` rack2 | 49.625, 1.325, down | ft2-tl, ft2-ar |
| `n1` rack2 (the walk test's `w:echo:rack`) | 52.075, 1.325, down | **ft2-r (the player)**, ft2-aar |
| `n2`, `n3` rack2 | 54.525 and 56.975, 1.325, down | ft1-tl, ft1-ar; ft1-aar, ft1-r |
| `s0`, `s1` rack2 | 49.625 and 52.075, 6.575, up | ft3-tl, ft3-ar; ft3-aar, ft3-r |

| `sl` rack1, along the east wall, the north-east corner | about 60.0, 1.4, left | sl |

The aisle is z 2.8 to 5.1 (centre 3.95); the door x 57.2 to 58.2 on z 7.6; the study table about (59.3, 6.8) is the fire watch's post with its red lamp (§8, item 9). The other bays' tables follow the same billet order on their layouts.

**`src/sim/places/fixtures.js`**: `CATALOGUE` adds `wallClock` (0.30 × 0.05 × 0.30, mount wall or desk, no block), `stairs` (1.2 × 4.8 × 3.4, no block, cost 15), `stairsWell` (1.2 × 4.8 × 1.0, blocks but its top `STAIR_TOP_M`), `lampPost` (0.25 × 0.25 × 4.0, blocks), equal to the kit's `FOOTPRINTS` (stage adds the same, §2.3). Kinds gain `seats: [{ n, dx, dz, y, use, head }]` numbered after the spots (rack2: spot #1 the foot, seats #2 lower y 0.45, #3 upper y 1.35; rack1: #2 y 0.45; footlocker: #2 y 0.40; stool, chair: their #1 spot is the seat, y 0.47 and 0.45). Seats are not walking spots (the walker's reach is over spots only). And:

```js
seatsOf(fx) → [{ id: '<fixture>#<n>', fixture, x, z, y, use, head: 'n' | 's' | 'e' | 'w' }]
seatOf(seatId) → { id, fixture, area, room, x, z, y, use, head, lockerId, footlockerId } | null     // from data alone
berthOf(unitId, billet) → seatId | null                 // the room whose owner is unitId, the rack listing billet
postOf(postId) → { id, unitId, area, seatId } | null
```

**`src/sim/places/model.js`**: keeps its exports; `enterSite(state, siteId, areaId)` makes the site's record `{ template }` (no seed: §8, item 2); `setOpening(state, id, s, { atMs = state.clock.ms })` writes `{ state, atMs }`; adds:

```js
placeLine(state) → 'Echo Company barracks · 1st Squad, 2nd Platoon'   // the live area's name and the room the player stands in
roomOf(areaId, x, z) → room record | null
surfaceAt(state, x, z, areaId = live) → 'tile' | 'vinyl' | 'concrete' | 'paving' | 'regolith' | 'stairs'
```

**`src/sim/places/sun.js`** (`Pure.`; TIME §1 and §2.5's definition, PLACES §3.15's horizon):

```js
sunAt(siteId, ms) → { elevDeg, azDeg, horizonDeg, eclipsed }   // mean solar time (meanSolarFrac at the site), δ = asin(sin 25.19° sin Ls); elevDeg rounded to 0.001
horizonAt(siteId, azDeg) → deg                                  // PLACES §3.15's walls with Mars's curvature, at least 1°
sunTimes(siteId, ms, { terrain = true } = {}) → { riseMs, setMs, dayH, noonElevDeg }   // for the sol holding ms; terrain false: the flat horizon
```

`azDeg` from north, clockwise; `eclipsed` when `elevDeg < horizonDeg`. The walls are `MELAS_WALLS = { southKm: 45, southRiseM: 8000, northKm: 150, northRiseM: 8000 }` in `src/data/places/melas.js` (§8, item 5).

**`src/sim/places/light.js`** (`Pure.`; TECH §9.6, correction 14; the only place light is computed):

```js
lightingOf(state, areaId, roomId, ms) → 'day' | 'evening' | 'lightsOut'    // by Melas time (§4) for the room's lighting class
lampsOf(state, areaId, ms) → frozen [{ i, x, z, y, r, core, ring, kind, color, room, on }]   // the same array object until a lamp changes
skyAt(siteId, ms) → { elevDeg, azDeg, eclipsed, sunColor, sunK, skyColor, skyK, ground, tint: [r, g, b], glow, shadow, level }
lightLevel(state, x, z, ms, areaId = live) → [0, 1]                         // rounded to 0.0001
```

Indoors: `min(1, max(fill, WINDOW_K × skyAt.level if the room has windows) + Σ pools)`, where `fill` is the room's class at its state (§4) and a pool is a lit lamp's `core` within `r` and `ring` within `1.5 r` (hard edges). Ceiling lamps make the fill and have no pool (§8, item 7); pools are the `night`, `red`, `desk`, `street` and `flood` kinds. Outdoors (the ground): `skyAt(...).level`, VIEWS §2.7's rows interpolated by the geometric elevation, at most the 0° row's 0.35 while `eclipsed`, plus the street and flood pools while the sun is under 0°. `skyAt` reads `src/data/places/sky.js`, which the stage reads for the colours: one table.

**`src/sim/places/doors.js`, `hand.js`**:

```js
toggleDoor(state, openingId, bus, { who }) → 'open' | 'closed' | null     // null: a doorway, a gate, or out of reach
leafAt(state, openingId, ms) → 0..1                                       // open fraction: the stage swings the leaf by it
handOffer(state) → { act: 'hand', verb: 'open' | 'close' | 'wait', target: openingId | null, label: 'open the door' | 'close the door' | 'wait 15 min' } | null
```

A door opens over its `openS` (`door` 1.0 s, `extDoor` 1.2 s; PLACES §1.6): the leaf blocks until `atMs`, then the cells are re-marked free; it closes at once (a walker in its cells is settled out, as built). Toggling emits `door { id, area, x, z, state, kind, who }`. The opening twinned on the ground (`door.opening`) is the same state. `handOffer` takes the nearest openable door within `DOOR_REACH_M` of the player, its band's middle in the player's facing half-plane (ties by `cmpId`); with none, the wait; null while time stands still or a skip runs. Actions (places' domain): `hand` (R) does what `handOffer` says (the wait is 0.0.2's `beginSkip({ activity: 'wait', planMs: WAIT_MS, mask: 'D' })`); `{ act: 'door', args: { id, to: 'open' | 'closed' } }` for tests and the debug handle.

**`src/sim/places/portals.js`**:

```js
portalCrossed(state, actor) → portal | null          // after the player's move (move.js calls it in layer 2)
moveTo(state, actorId, { area, x, z, face }, bus, { portal = null, why = 'portal' } = {}) → state.places.live
routeAcross(from: { area, x, z }, to: { area, x, z }) → [{ area, from: [x, z], to: [x, z], portal }]   // legs for bots
```

`moveTo` (the cross-area move, the player's): `area-leave` then `area-enter` (`{ site, area, from, portal }`), `places.live` set, the actor placed at `to` with `$px`, `$pz` equal (no glide), settled, `autosave { why: 'area' }` asked (time's `askAutosave`), a log record `{ kind: 'place', tone: 'note', text: '<area name>.' }`. The view's cut is main.js's (§2.4).

**`src/sim/places/sight.js`** (PEOPLE §7.6's sight grid):

```js
sightGridOf(state, areaId, x, z) → { areaId, x0, z0, nx, nz, cellM: 0.25, bits: Uint8Array, gen }
```

Cells on the area frame's 0.25 m lattice (x0, z0 multiples of 0.25: the nav's and the fog mask's lattice; 0.5 m as first built, which let an eye pressed to a wall see through it, the review's finding, fixed by the fixer: no walker's centre, C0 0.27 m from a face, is ever in a wall's cell). Bits `PRONE` 1, `CROUCH` 2, `STAND` 4: a cell takes every layer up to its blocker's sight height (wall runs and closed leaves: all three; a fixture by its kind's `sightH`, its `h` unless the catalogue says otherwise: rack2 and rack1 1.0, so a standing eye sees into a bay's racks, §8, item 12; lockers, stalls, showers, rack3 by their `h`; wall pieces, chairs, stools none; massing: all three; the fence and gates none). A cell is marked when a blocker overlaps its interior by more than 1 mm (a 0.16 m wall never leaks). A floor's grid covers the area (cached); a ground's is a window `SIGHT_WINDOW_M` 192 m wide holding (x, z) at least `SIGHT_EDGE_M` 56 m from its edge (past sight's 54 m reach; 128 and 32 m as first built), rebuilt by chunks, only the window's chunks kept. A door's change re-marks its cells and bumps `gen`.

**`src/sim/places/clocks.js`** (`Pure.`): `wallClockAt(fixture, ms, lonEDeg) → { faces: [{ face: 'melas' | 'utc', hour, minute, slip, text: 'HH:MM', hourDeg, minuteDeg }] }` from `dates.js`' `marsClock` and core's `utc` (the watch's own helpers). Through the slip the Melas face reads `24:00` and its hands stand at 12 (`slip: true`).

**`src/sim/places/nav.js`**: `navOf(state, areaId, cls, x = null, z = null)`: a floor's grid as built; a ground's a window holding (x, z) at least `NAV_EDGE_M` from its edge, made of `CHUNK_M` chunks built lazily and ahead (at most `NAV_CHUNKS_TICK` per class per tick once the walk is under way: work units, TECH correction 7), cached in `$places.nav`. Blockers on the ground: the massing (but its door reveals while open), the fence, closed gates, blocking ground fixtures. Costs: paving and floors 10, regolith 13, stairs 15. `requestPath`, `path`, `pathsStep` keep their contracts.

**`src/sim/places/domain.js`**: `placesDomain` adds `actions: { hand, door }`, `upgrades: [['places:no-site-seed', fn]]` (drops `places.sites[*].seed`, `flags['mig:no-site-seed']`), `idFields` adding `'places.nav.pending[].who': 'a'` if not walked by name. `fast.player` is `move.js` `playerStep`, which now reads `navOf(state, area, PLAYER_CLS, a.x, a.z)` and calls `portalCrossed` after the move.

**`tests/bots/lib.mjs`**: `goTo(target, { cls, openDoors = true })` presses R (act `hand`) when its path fails `locked` and `handOffer` names the blocking door; new `crossTo({ area, x, z }, { cls })` walks `routeAcross`'s legs through their portals. **`walker.mjs`**: `walkFloors(game, { cls })` (every spot of both Echo floors, through the stairs) and `walkToFences(game, { cls })` (§5.1).

### 2.2 people

**`src/sim/people/domain.js`**: `peopleDomain`, replacing game.js's stub: keys `player, people, units, happenings, actors, mind, talk, names`; `idMaps: { people: 'p', units: 'unit' }`; `idFields: { 'player.id': 'p', 'player.actor': 'a' }` (`who`, `*Id` fields are walked by name: `berthId`, `spotId`, `parentId`); `fast: { actors: actorsStep }` (layer 3); `slow: [{ name: 'people:place', step, steady: () => true }]` (in a skip, every actor takes its wanted pose at the step's end: TIME §5.9); `actions: { people: noop, instinct: noop }`.

**`src/sim/people/roster.js`** (PEOPLE §3; LONGHAUL's pools and tradecraft's shape, adapted):

```js
ROSTER_UNITS            // ['2/4', '2/4-E', '2/4-E-1', '2/4-E-1-1' … '2/4-E-3-3']: company HQ (billets on '2/4-E', PEOPLE §2.6) and the three rifle platoons
rollRoster(state, { companyId = '2/4-E', leave = { unitId: '2/4-E-2-1', billet: 'ft2-r' } }) → { people, units, ms }
fillPlayer(state, { unitId = '2/4-E-2-1', billet = 'ft2-r' }) → personId    // a generated person in the empty billet, made the player
```

Each person from `stream('roster', meta.seed, unitId, billet)` (PEOPLE §3.1), so one billet's dice never move another's and the world gives the same company; ids `p<n>` by `nextId` in billet order (the company HQ, then platoons 1 to 3, platoon HQ before squads, squads by fire team); the player takes the next id after the roster. This round: 144 generated and the player (145: §8, item 4). Each person: name (PEOPLE §3.5 from `src/data/setting/names.js`, the registry `state.names.people` keeping full names unique, SETTING §12.6's blocklist), sex (30% women, every billet), rank by the billet's weights, grade, MOS, age by PEOPLE §3.3 (`bornMs`), `enlistedMs`, home and culture (SETTING §4.7's shares, `homes.js`), background, the six axes (NCOs and up as PEOPLE §3.6 says), two tags with exclusions (PEOPLE §3.6; tiers 1 and 2 are all there is this round), a quirk (tier 1; 50% of tier 2), a nickname (40% tier 1, 20% tier 2), tier (1: the 1st Squad, 2nd Platoon's HQ, the company's commander, first sergeant and gunnery sergeant; 2: the rest), `body: { v: 1, tmpl, heightM, build }` (data only: the figures stay the samples' set), `look: { skin, hair: { style, color }, seed }` within the kit's ranges (skin light, tan, brown, dark; hair crew, short, bald for men, bun, short for women; colours black, dark, brown, auburn, blond, grey), and `berthId = berthOf(unitId, billet)`. Every pair of the 1st Squad differs in at least two of skin, hair style, hair colour (redrawn on the squad's stream up to 10 times: VIEWS §3.9). Ties, arcs, skills, needs, kit and career timelines are not rolled this round.

**`src/sim/people/place.js`**:

```js
FIRE_WATCH_POST = 'fire-watch:2/4-E-2'
fireWatchOf(state) → personId                 // stream('roster', seed, '2/4-E-2', 'fire-watch'): a Pvt to LCpl of 2nd Platoon's 2nd or 3rd Squad
placed(state) → [personId]                    // this round: the 1st Squad's 12, the fire watch, the player
whereIs(state, personId, ms) → { area, x, z, y, face, posture: 'stand' | 'sit' | 'lie', spotId, outfit: 'pt' | 'utilities', curtain }
                             | { away: true }
syncActors(state)                             // the live area's actors: the player's kept, the others made at whereIs, behind the cut
actorsStep(state, input, bus, ctx)            // layer 3: syncActors on an area change; else each placed person, on its second bucket, takes whereIs if the player cannot see it
```

`whereIs` for a placed person: from taps to reveille (§4), lying in their berth (`posture 'lie'`, `y` the seat's, `head` the seat's, PT kit, `curtain` by `hash01('curtain', id, solIndex) < CURTAIN_FRAC` where the rack has curtains); otherwise at their rack by `hashInt(3, 'pose', id, floor(ms / POSE_PERIOD_MS))`: the lower berth's sleeper sits on the rack's edge or stands at their locker, the upper's sits on the footlocker or stands at their locker (no two on one spot), utilities, no cover indoors. The fire watch: sitting at the post's seat from taps to reveille, by day at their berth in bay-2-2 as above. Everyone else: `away` (exists in state, no actor). **A pose changes only while the player cannot see the person** (`canSee` false; checked on the person's bucket second, `phase mod 20 = hash(id) mod 20`, CONTRACTS §5), so nobody jumps in sight; at an area entry and after a skip every actor takes `whereIs` at once (behind the cut, or the skip). Actors are made with new `a<n>` ids each entry, the player's kept.

**`src/sim/people/figure.js`** (`Pure.`; what the stage reads to draw anyone):

```js
figureOf(state, actor) → { look,             // a wear() spec: the person's look with the outfit now and head: null indoors
                           posture: 'stand' | 'sit' | 'lie', y, face, head, curtain, gait, strideM }
```

The player's figure is `posture 'stand'` with the actor's gait and stride; a person without people data (the sandbox's) draws as before.

**`src/sim/people/perception.js`** (`Pure.`; PEOPLE §7.1, §7.2, §7.6, sight only; tradecraft v0.2.0-rc3 `src/sim/perception.js` (265 lines) `eyes()` and `openness()` adapted, its rays replaced by the sight grid):

```js
eyeOf(state, actor) → { x, z, headRad, coneRad (half-angle), awareM, eyeLayer: 'stand' | 'crouch' | 'prone', asleep, areaId }
clearLine(grid, ax, az, bx, bz, layer) → bool  // symmetric; a diagonal crack through two blocking corners blocks; the two end cells never block
visibility(state, eye, x, z, ms = state.clock.ms) → 0..1   // the one primitive: openness (cone, awareness radius, reach 10 + 42 × lightLevel) × clearLine
sightOf(state, viewerActor, targetActor) → { vis, seen }   // seen = vis ≥ SEEN; a target behind its own drawn curtain is seen only within 1 m
canSee(state, viewerActor, targetActor) → bool
sightMask(state, eye, mask) → mask    // mask { x0, z0, nx, nz, cellM: 0.25, vis: Float32Array(nx × nz) }: vis[k] = visibility() at cell k's centre, exactly (0.5 m as first built: the fixer's 0.25 m, VIEWS §2.11)
```

The player's Awareness is `PLAYER_AWARENESS` until SKILLS. `sightMask` may use any algorithm whose output equals `visibility` at every cell (the test proves it); the fog and the poses read the same function.

**`src/sim/people/hearing.js`** (PEOPLE §7.3's one air law, the audio's too): `AIR_REF_KPA 101.3`, `AIR_MIN_KPA 0.1`, `airK(pKpa)`, `airDb(pKpa)`.

**`src/sim/scenarios/barracks.js`**: `BARRACKS = { site: 'melas', area: 'melas.echo.1' }`; `barracks(state, { at = null } = {})`: `rollRoster`, `fillPlayer`, the player's actor at their berth's foot spot (`#1`) facing down, or at `at = { area, x, z, face }`; `enterSite`; `syncActors`. `career` stays null (ROADMAP §2.1).

**`src/sim/game.js`**: `SCENARIOS = { sandbox, barracks }`; `newGame({ …, at = null })` moves the clock for `hour` **before** the scenario's fill (at Melas's longitude, the scenario's site; §8, item 20) and passes `{ at }` to it; the tech domain's debug action adds `debug:go:<areaId>:<x>:<z>[:<face>]` (marks `meta.debugUsed`, calls `moveTo`).

### 2.3 stage

```js
createView({ stage, painter, uploads, ppm })          // as built (prop gone with the soldier figure, the fixer's), plus:
view.prepare(area) → Promise<info>     // builds an area into the cache without showing it (AREA_CACHE 3: the ground and both floors)
view.setArea(area) → Promise<info>     // as built: from the cache at once if prepared
view.frame(alpha, state, info)         // info { lonEDeg, held, cut, paused }
view.fog → { x0, z0, nx, nz, vis: Float32Array } | null    // the wanted values of the last recompute (before easing), for render-fog
view.stats  // as built, plus clocks: [{ id, faces: [{ hour, minute, slip }] }], lamps: { table, slots }, chunks: { built, building },
            // people: { drawn, lying }, area: { id, buildMs, cutMs }
```

What the view reads, and from whom: the area record (main.js passes `areaOf(id)`); `state.actors.list` and `figureOf(state, actor)` for every figure (posture `stand` by gait frames, `sit` the `sit` frame lifted to `y`, `lie` the `sleep` frame on the berth by its `head`, the curtain drawn over it where `curtain`); `lampsOf(state, areaId, ms)` for the static pools (TECH §9.6's tiled table, or slots that provably cover every lamp in the frame plus 4 m: no pool may appear or vanish as the camera moves), `skyAt(siteId, ms)` and `sunAt` for the key light (its elevation, colour and strength; the screen azimuth stays the art's upper left, VIEWS §2.7; off with no shadows while `eclipsed`) and the sky fill; `lightingOf` for the interior mood; `lightLevel` for every sprite's tint (the tint's brightness a monotone function of it); `wallClockAt` for every `wallClock` fixture's hands; `leafAt` for every door's leaf, 0 shut to 1 open (props, TECH §9.2); `sightMask(state, eyeOf(state, playerActor(state)), mask)` for the fog of awareness, recomputed when the eyes move 0.25 m or turn, a door in reach moves, and once a game second (VIEWS §2.11), eased and dithered by `fog.js` as built.

What it draws: the ground of Base Melas by `CHUNK_M` chunks built ahead within `REACH_M` and dropped beyond `DROP_M` (TECH §9.3: the worker builds, a site's tiles painted once, ground runs, at most `CHUNK_FRAME_MS` of main-thread work a frame, uploads within `UPLOAD_BYTES_FRAME`), so no chunk pops into view; the valley floor's materials, roads, paths, the parade deck with its lines, the fence and closed gates, the massing as walls with roofs; Echo's floors through the cutaway; the stairs (a dissolve round the stair over `STAIR_DISSOLVE_S` when both floors are built, else the cut: VIEWS §2.9); see-through occluders (VIEWS §2.10: a mass between the camera and the player dissolves above `CUT_H_M` in the protected rectangle, roofs hidden, over `SEE_DISSOLVE_S` both ways, the player's silhouette at 60% ink through it). Kit: `wallClock` (a face and two hands drawn from `wallClockAt`), `stairs`, `stairsWell`, `lampPost`, with `FOOTPRINTS` equal to places' catalogue (§2.1); door leaves; the stencil glyphs fixed (the look round's "2ND SQUAD" read "EUND"); a body lying in a rack reads as lying (L5), and the ceiling-lamp pools no longer blotch the floor (L1, L3: §8, item 7).

### 2.4 hud

**`src/main.js`**: New career starts `newGame({ scenario: 'barracks', mode })` at `START_MS` (Monday, Sol 590 of MY 211, 12:39:34 Melas time: CONTRACTS §2, §3); `?play=sandbox` stays the test rooms; `?play=barracks&hour=<h>&seed=<n>[&at=<x>,<z>&area=<id>&face=<f>]`. On `area-enter` it holds the cut (`'cut'`, at most `CUT_MAX_MS`) while `view.setArea(areaOf(area))` builds, then `view.prepare()`s the areas the live area's portals lead to, one at a time, while play runs. The HUD rectangles are VIEWS §7.5's (`TOASTS`, `WATCH`, `INSTINCT`, `KEYS`, `PAUSED`), never overlapping, sized by `--ui`. `?bench=squadbay-night` (and `?bench=1`, the same) starts the bench (below).

**`src/ui/hud/watch.js`**: `watchFaces(state) → { time: 'HH:MM', slip, sol: 'Sol 590 · MY 211', weekday: 'Monday', utc: utcText(ms), place: placeLine(state) }`, from `dates.js` and `calendar.js` (the wall clocks' helpers). The watch shows the time large, then the weekday and sol, then UTC on its second line, then the place.

**`src/ui/hud/toasts.js`**: the last `TOASTS_MAX` of `log` facts (records) and `line` facts, each `TOAST_S` while play runs, in `TOASTS`. **`hud/offer.js`**: `INSTINCT`'s line shows `handOffer(state)`: a keycap in the player's layout and the label ("R open the door"), every frame, nothing while null. **`cards/log.js`**: J opens the log card (paused): the last `LOG_CARD_LINES` records of `state.log`, newest last. **`cards/keys.js`**: ? lists every key that does something in this build, labelled AZERTY (Z Q S D walk, Shift run, Alt stroll, R what's at hand: a door, else wait 15 min, G weapon ready (time stands still), digits, J log, Space pause, Esc menu, ? keys; in debug ^ and $). **`cards/menu.js`**: the Esc menu adds master volume (0 to 1) and mute, saved in the profile (`store.putProfile({ …profile, audio: { volume, muted } })`).

**`src/ui/audio/`** (VIEWS §11; WebAudio, every sound synthesised at runtime from `src/data/sounds.js`'s parameters, unscored until the sound gallery):

```js
createAudio({ profile }) → { start(), setVolume(v), setMuted(on), frame(state, alpha, nowS), door(fact), dispose(), stats }
footfalls(prevStrideM, strideM, gait) → [fractions]    // pure (steps.js): a foot-fall at each half of the gait's four-step cycle (walk 0.64, run 1.8 m: STRIDE_WRAP_M divides both)
stepVoice(surface, gait) → { kind: 'tile' | 'concrete' | 'regolith', gainDb, lowpassHz }   // pure
```

Nothing is made before the first key or click (`start()` creates and resumes the `AudioContext` then: autoplay rules). Each frame `frame()` reads the player's actor (`strideM`, `gait`) and `surfaceAt` under the feet (tile and vinyl as tile, concrete and paving as concrete, regolith), and schedules the foot-falls crossed with a short look-ahead; `door` facts schedule the door's open or close. The air: `gainDb = weightDb + airDb(65.9) = −4.2 − 1.9 = −6.1 dB` against Earth (VIEWS §11.3's `10 log₁₀(g / 9.81)` at 0.38 G, PEOPLE §7.3's air law), low-passed at `8 kHz × 65.9 / 101.3 = 5.2 kHz` (VIEWS §11.2's filter); indoors the same air (66 kPa, CONTRACTS §16).

**`src/core/debug.js`**: `readParams` adds `bench`, `area`, `at` ([x, z]), `face`; the handle adds `area` (the live area's id), `go(area, x, z, face)` (queues `debug:go`), `door(id, to)` (queues the `door` action), `actors()` (each actor with its person's name, posture, outfit, seen), `light(x, z)` (`lightLevel` now), `sun()` (`sunAt` now), `sightMask()` (people's, for the player now), `offer()`.

**The bench** (ROADMAP §4.6, TECH §13.4): `src/data/bench.js` `BENCH_SCENES['squadbay-night'] = { play: 'barracks', seed: 48213, hour: 23, at: { area: 'melas.echo.1', x: 54.8, z: 3.95, face: 'right' }, keys: [['KeyD', 4000], ['KeyA', 8000], ['KeyD', 4000], [null, 4000]], warmS: 2 }` (20 s, the aisle walked east, west and back, then still; read by the stage's `render-bench` too). `src/ui/cards/bench.js` runs it with no saves and shows: frame median, p95, p99, frames over 25 ms, draw calls (max), triangles, programs, uploads (max bytes a frame), view CPU (median, p95), the renderer string (`WEBGL_debug_renderer_info`), DPR, the window, `hardwareConcurrency`, the density, the version, with **Copy results**; `window.__bench` holds the same object once done.

## 5. Tests

Names are sentences; numbers printed six spaces in; assertions carry their evidence. Each line: the test; **prints**; **holds**.

### 5.1 places

- **`places-validate`** (quick, extended). The test area as before; `melas.echo.1`, `melas.echo.2` and `melas.ground` by §2.1's rules and PLACES §9.6's (openings join two rooms, every room has one, door clear zones, fixtures in their rooms and apart, the heads' standard, 15 berths a squad bay covering the squad's 13 and 2 spare, the 1st Squad's berth table as §2.1's, portals' hysteresis, links' stops aligned, decor on full-height walls, an exit sign at every portal, seeds per kind, catalogue sizes equal to `FOOTPRINTS`), and a new barracks game's `places.sites` holding no seed; each rule failing on a sample made to break it; **prints** counts per rule and area, the fixtures per kind per floor, and goldens of each area record, echo.1's C0 grid and `MELAS_PLAN`; **holds** no problem.
- **`places-reach`** (quick, extended). Every spot of both Echo floors reachable from every portal for C0, C1, C2 by A* with the doors open (a door is R away); **prints** spots per floor, unreachable pairs by class; **holds** none unreachable.
- **`places-portals`** (quick). ## 6. Acceptance checks for the integrator

**In node**
1. `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs`: green, the quick total under 60 s.
2. `node tests/run.mjs places-light`: read the bay's and the street's levels and the terrain sunrise and sunset (for PLACES §3.15 and CONTRACTS §3); `node tests/run.mjs places-walkers` (heavy): every spot of both floors, every gate, the player layer's cost.
3. `PRINT_HASH=1 node tests/run.mjs places-validate people-roster game-determinism`: paste the goldens that moved; the sandbox's moves for the site seed's removal (and nothing else: say so in CHANGELOG), the roster's is new.
4. `node tests/run.mjs syntax`: the new `SIM_FOR_VIEW` modules, the WebAudio rule, `door` registered and emitted.

**In the browser** (by hand on `python3 tools/serve.py 8231 .`, killed after; the tests on 8232: `OLYMPUS_TEST_PORT=8232 node tests/run.mjs browser`, every `*browser` and the heavy suites, then read their numbers)
5. **The bay at 23:00**: `/?play=barracks&hour=23&seed=48213`. In bay-2-1 at the foot of your rack, the overheads off, the fire watch at the study table under the red lamp; twelve squadmates lying in their racks, some behind drawn curtains, read as lying at both densities (`&ppm=16`). The wall clock on the north wall shows 11:00 with the watch's 23:00, Monday, Sol 590. Walk the aisle: the fog dims behind you and through the walls; nobody appears, vanishes or changes posture while in sight.
6. **To the morning**: `&debug=1`, then `$` (an hour each) until the watch reads about 05:00, and R (15 minutes each) to 05:30, when the lights come on; look back at the squad: they are up only once you have looked away. Or straight in: `/?play=barracks&hour=5.67&seed=48213`.
7. **The stairs, and out at dawn**: R at the bay door, into hall-2, east to the stair, up to the Weapons Platoon's wing and down again (the stair at the same pixels both floors); west to the core, the lobby's duty desk with its two-faced clock agreeing with the watch, R at the vestibule's two doors, out onto Echo's street before 05:44. The street in the canyon's shade, no shadows; at the terrain sunrise the key light comes on low from the east and the shadows lengthen. Each cut ≤ 1 s.
8. **Across the base to its fences**: north round the barracks' west end to the north fence, west along it to the main gate (closed), south and east: chunks never pop, buildings between you and the camera dissolve round you, the walk stops at the fence. Back in by the front door.
9. **Night outside**: `/?play=barracks&hour=23&seed=48213&area=melas.ground&at=530,224`: the street lamps' pools, the fence's floods, the dark between, the fog's reach shorter in the dark.
10. **New career** from the title (Standard and Ironman): Monday, Sol 590 · 12:39, in the bay, the squad sitting and standing at their racks; a reload's Continue carries on; the sandbox still walks the test rooms.
11. **Sound**: after the first key, footsteps on the bay's tile, on the street's paving and on regolith off the paths, quieter than the samples on Earth would be; the doors' sounds; the menu's volume and mute.
12. **The bench**: `/?bench=squadbay-night` at 16 and 24 px/m: the card, Copy; then ask the user to run it on Windows (`play.cmd --dev`, the same URL) and paste the result.
13. Shots, looked at: `node tools/shot.mjs "http://localhost:8231/?play=barracks&hour=23&seed=48213&nostore=1" <scratch>/bay23.png --size 1600x900`, then `hour=12.67`, `hour=5.75&area=melas.ground&at=522,224`, `&ppm=16`: pixels on the palette, outlines crisp, no blotched floors, legible stencils, no seams between chunks.

## 7. Not in this release

People's AI, schedules (the Plan of the Day lived by anyone), walking NPCs, booking and queues, needs, talk, barks, customs, hearing as perception (only `airDb` exists), memory and the fog's ghosts (`state.mind.seen`), the felt; the roster's weapons platoon and T3 staff, ties, arcs, skills, kit, career timelines; the other squads and platoons placed (they exist, `away`); the duty roster's rotation and the fire watch's rounds and torch. BODY's gaits, stair speeds, bounding, stamina, the head-strike (0.0.5). Sleep, the splash, activities, interrupts (0.0.5). Interiors of any building but Echo; the gates opening, the gate guard, Melas Halt, the districts beyond the apron, the static index, the far window, the Loop (0.0.12, 0.1). Mars weather, dust, the sky view, Phobos and Deimos, the temperature (0.0.12, 0.2). The sound gallery and scoring, the bugle, the PA, the wind, convolvers, occlusion, captions (0.1). The look's new frames (stroll, look, glance, stairs, the shower) and E look (after the scores). Settings, the debug card, overlays, the degrade ladder, the bench's other scenes (0.1). Rack curtains, locker doors and lights as saved fixture state (0.0.9).

## 8. Resolutions, and doc changes for the lead

Implementation matters by TECH §1.3, the rest by DESIGN.md and the two rules; each (my call) unless a source is named.

1. **Numbering**: ROADMAP §4.1's 0.0.4 row ships as v0.0.3 (CONTRACTS §18).
2. **The site seed is gone** (the first rule). Nothing in a layout or its dressing reads a seed of the world: `places.sites[*]` keeps `{ template, openings }`; weather and every later procedural thing draws from the world's seed by name (`stream('weather', meta.seed, siteId, my)`), not from a site seed. PLACES §1.2, §1.10, §2.4 (chunk dressing from the area's authored `look.seed`), §9.1 (rule-placed fixtures are authored deterministic rules), §9.2 (dressing streams become authored constants), §9.3 ("three kinds" authored), §9.4 (variety measured over the authored rooms, not seeds), §9.5 (the Talus laid by tools and committed) are corrected to match.
3. **All people generated** (the second rule), the player too: a generated person fills the empty billet until CAREER's enlistment paper (0.0.13).
4. **Echo is 145 this round.** PEOPLE §3.2's weapons platoon (2 + 19 + 13 + 13 = 47) disagrees with its stated 46 and CONTRACTS §15's 191; it is not generated until PEOPLE settles it (CONTRACTS §19, a new item).
5. **The sun** is `src/sim/places/sun.js` this round (TIME §1 owns the definition; `sunAt(siteId, ms)`): TIME §2.5's mean solar time and declination, no equation of time (VIEWS §2.7 dropped Mars24's true solar time: "Mars24" reads as its declination on the calendar's Ls). The walls' four numbers live in `src/data/places/melas.js` `MELAS_WALLS`, and stay there: they are PLACES's data, read by `sun.js`, and SETTING's `SITES.melas` does not carry them (the docs round's call, SETTING §3.8, PLACES §3.15); one record.
6. **The key light**: its elevation, colour and strength follow `sunAt`; its screen azimuth stays the art's upper left (VIEWS §2.7, tradecraft's rule).
7. **Ceiling lamps make a room's fill, not pools** (the look round's L1 and L3 blotches); pools are the night, red, desk, street and flood lamps. VIEWS §2.7's interior table reads this way.
8. **Moment 2's stairs**: 2nd Platoon sleeps on the ground floor (PLACES §4.4, the walk test's waypoints), so the walk goes up the east stair and down again before it goes out (ROADMAP §4.4 reads so).
9. **The fire watch**: one person of 2nd Platoon's 2nd or 3rd Squad, drawn once per world, stands every night's watches at bay-2-1's study table with a red-lensed lamp (no AI, no rounds), so the bay holds CONTRACTS §8's 14 (the squad of 13 with you, and the fire watch). The duty roster rotates it at 0.0.14; the torch as a moving pool comes with AI.
10. **Who is placed**: the 1st Squad, the fire watch and you; everyone else exists in state, `away`.
11. **No pops without AI**: a pose changes only while you cannot see the person (the one sight function), and all at once behind a cut or a skip (TIME §5.9).
12. **Racks do not block a standing eye** (`sightH` 1.0): PEOPLE §7.6's "full-height racks" are rack3 and the berth couches.
13. **A line's two end cells never block it**, so a wall's face lights when seen and a body in a rack is seen from the aisle.
14. **The sight grid is PLACES's** (PEOPLE §7.6's ask); the fog's mask is computed by the stage calling people's `sightMask` (TECH §9.11's step 9), not by the sim's `look` step, until sightings need it (0.0.10). One function either way, proven by `render-fog`.
15. **R is what's at hand**: a door within reach, else the 15-minute wait (0.0.2's R kept as the fallback). The `hand` action moves from TIME's domain to PLACES's.
16. **Audio** lives in `src/ui/audio/` (TECH §2.1). The air law is PEOPLE §7.3's `airDb` (−1.9 dB at Melas), replacing VIEWS §11.2's −3.7 dB as PEOPLE says; VIEWS's low-pass stays; the foot's weight −4.2 dB (VIEWS §11.3). Parameters in `src/data/sounds.js`, unscored until the sound gallery (VIEWS §11.5).
17. **Name pools** in `src/data/setting/names.js` and homes in `homes.js` (SETTING §12, §4.7; TECH correction 11), copied from LONGHAUL's `js/sim/names.js` and `careers.js` lists with SETTING's additions and blocklist.
18. **The scenario is `barracks`** (TECH §2.1's list gains `scenarios/barracks.js`; `squadbay` stays the bench scene's name).
19. **The gates are closed this release**: the walk ends at the fences, the gate posts open them at 0.0.12.
20. **`newGame` moves the clock before the scenario's fill**, so a start at 23:00 places the squad asleep (the clock is Melas's longitude, the barracks' site).
21. **Outfits**: PT kit in the rack, utilities by day, covers off indoors (the Corps' custom; VIEWS §3.4's `squadbay-night` "sleepers in PT kit").
22. **The bench scene** is key holds in `src/data/bench.js`, one definition for the page's card and the stage's test.
23. **A floor's `boundsM` is its rooms' envelope**, so `wallsOf` stands the north boundary full height; the lobby block's south face is drawn as an inner wall.
24. **Wall clocks hang on full-height walls only**; the lobby's two-faced clock stands on the duty desk (the cutaway leaves the lobby no back wall).

**Doc changes for the lead**: CHANGELOG.md and README's "Where it stands"; DESIGN.md's decision log (items 2 to 5, 8 to 16, 19 to 21); PLACES §1.2, §1.10, §2.4, §9 (2), §1.5 (seats, `sightH`, the new kinds), §3.9 (7, the lighting classes), §3.15 and §4.1 (10.5° S, the terrain times from `places-light`), §4.4 (the berth table, the fire watch's post, 24); PEOPLE §3.2 (4), §3.12 (3), §7.6 (12 to 14); TIME §1 (5), §5.9 (11); VIEWS §2.7 (6, 7), §11.2 (16); TECH §2.1 (16, 18, the new places and people files), §2.2 (`SIM_FOR_VIEW`); CONTRACTS §3 (the terrain sunrise and sunset), §11 (`door`), §13 (`sunAt`'s home), §19 (4, and item 11 closed by the reprint); ROADMAP §4.4 (8); SETTING §3.8 (5).
